title: Psychedelics align brain activity with context.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Listed the OpenNeuro ds006110 S3 bucket (version 1.2.2, CC0 licence, no login): 64 subject folders, participants.tsv with 64 rows (age, dose in mg/kg). Opened phenotype/scored/ses-02/EDI.tsv (62 data rows; EDI_ONE has NaNs) and ASC11.tsv headers (11 subscales of the altered-states questionnaire). Listed sub-PC001 raw func (4 echoes x 4 tasks, 80-190 MB each), EEG (91 MB BrainVision file) and fMRIPrep func outputs (voxelwise preprocessed BOLD, 60-240 MB per run, plus confound TSVs). Found no parcellated (region-level) time series in the derivatives.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: 62 analysed participants, fMRI about 80 min and EEG about 150 min after dose, the trajectory-based ML method and its correlation with experience scores, and the next-day mindset-change result; I did not open the follow-up MINDSET table rows or the paper's analysis code.

a1_downloadable.note: OpenNeuro ds006110, CC0, public S3 listing works without login (checked). Only sensitive demographics need a data-access agreement.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Subjective-experience scores are ready columns: EDI (ego-dissolution inventory) and ASC11 (11-dimension altered-states scale) TSVs in derivatives/phenotype/scored/ses-02 (opened).

a3_inputs_present.note: Raw and fMRIPrep-preprocessed BOLD (fMRI signal) NIfTI images and raw EEG are present, but only voxelwise; region-level time series would have to be built by parcellating every run yourself.

a4_units_stated.note: Questionnaire JSONs document which items are averaged into each subscale; dose is in mg/kg (checked).

a5_enough_rows.note: The labelled unit is the participant: EDI.tsv has 62 rows (opened). Even counting every scan, 62 subjects x 2 sessions x 4 tasks is about 500 scans that are not independent. Well under the 400-row floor for classification at the honest unit.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: About 60 GB of preprocessed voxelwise fMRI (64 subjects x 8 runs x ~120 MB per MNI-space run, extrapolated from sub-PC001); parcellated tables would be a few hundred MB once built.
a6_fits_laptop.note: No region-level time series are deposited, so download plus parcellation of every run is required; streaming per file is possible but slow.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Paper says 62 adults; bucket has 64 subject folders and participants.tsv 64 rows, EDI.tsv 62 rows. Plausible exclusions, not checked against the paper.

a8_label_provenance.note: Labels are self-report questionnaires filled in by participants, not model outputs and not computed from brain data.

existing_models.name: This paper's own trajectory model (low-dimensional embeddings of each person's brain dynamics, Stoliker et al. 2026)
existing_models.score_and_split: Reported correlations between context alignment and ego-dissolution / mindset change across 62 participants; no held-out test set described in what I read.
existing_models.authors_named_unsolved: Not checked in the full discussion.

backbone.name: None fitting the CHECKLIST list; fMRI foundation models (e.g. BrainLM) exist but were not evaluated here

integration.partner_dataset: Other public psychedelic fMRI datasets (e.g. LSD/psilocybin studies) were not located on OpenNeuro in this evaluation
integration.join_key: None; participants are unique to this study
integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: Whether a brain signature of ego dissolution learned here transfers to another drug or site, which needs a second dataset not found.

controls.positive_control: Drug versus baseline session classification from functional connectivity (a known large effect).

honest_claim_h3: Among 62 healthy adults scanned once on 19 mg psilocybin at one site, brain-dynamics features correlate with their own self-reported ego dissolution.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use brain scans recorded during a psilocybin session to predict how strongly each person reported their sense of self dissolving.
plain_idea.train_on: Functional MRI (fMRI, brain blood-flow signal) recordings during rest, meditation, music and movie, before and on the drug day, for 62 labelled participants (verified from EDI.tsv).
plain_idea.predict: Self-reported ego-dissolution and altered-states questionnaire scores, filled in by participants after the session.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Psychedelic-therapy researchers want a brain marker of a therapeutic experience; but 62 people is too few for a model to show this out of sample.

ml_idea: Predict per-subject ego-dissolution (EDI) and altered-states (ASC11) scores from parcellated fMRI connectivity during psilocybin; killed by n = 62 subjects and no region-level derivatives.

effort.compute_note: Estimated from file sizes listed for sub-PC001 extrapolated to 64 subjects; nothing timed.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count rows in EDI.tsv: 62 labelled participants (done; kills it).

verdict_reason: A5 fails: openly downloadable (CC0, OpenNeuro) but the labelled unit is the participant, and only 62 have experience scores (EDI.tsv opened). Also A6: no region-level time series, so about 60 GB of voxelwise fMRI must be parcellated first.
